Production root: media/showcase
Pose sheet handoff:
**Summary**: `v3/poses/s01-arrival-overwhelm.json` now names, for each of the eight chart keys, the reference card it borrows curve class, weight kind and lead from (nine `eagle_board.py apply` uses recorded), the plate family it is cut from, and the `solved` joints `solvePose` draws for the declaration (`npm run solve-poses -- s01-arrival-overwhelm`, new). The solved-joints probe passes on the sheet; the key sheet from run 1 fails the measured-joints probe on 8 of 8 keys, which is the re-key brief.

## Context
Shot s01-arrival-overwhelm, 420 frames. Inputs read: `v3/charts/s01-arrival-overwhelm.json` (keys), `v3/layouts/s01-arrival-overwhelm.json` (camera now ends at zoom 0.6), `v3/blocking/arrival.json`, `everything-at-once.json`, `assets/human/model.json` and `skeleton.json`, `v3/references/owner/picks.json`, `v3/rubric.md` v1.9 (C16, C21, C31-C33), `src/library/animation/pose.ts`.

## Analysis
- The run 1 declarations were a first reading from the chart's prose. Re-reading each key against the cards, the curve class and lead stayed; what changed is provenance (a named card per key), the plate family, and the lead leg of joy-b (the kick card has opposite arm and leg lead: arm R, leg L).
- Twinning: solved grip scored 0.71 and brace 0.73 (over 0.7) with no reason given. The solver leaves both legs near mirror in an upright stance (thigh and shin within 1-4 degrees) and a lead leg moves the ankle only, so adding one to grip made it worse (0.79). Both are matched gestures on purpose (both hands take the lid; both hands drawn to the chest), so each now carries `twinned.why`. This is a declaration, not a change to `solvePose`; the plates will show whether it is the right call.
- `solvePose` reads back every declared class with the bow within 0.02 (`check-pose.mjs` 8 of 8) and the weight check passes on all 8 solved keys, so no solver defect was found.

## Goals
Pose sheet judged before any plate exists (`--joints solved`); key sheet re-cut per plate family from the sheet; cards recorded so the ledger can say which reference led to which key.

## Execution
Poses (key · frame · curve class/bow/sign/lean · weight · lead arm/leg · silhouette · family · card):

| key | frame | curve | weight | lead | silhouette | family | card |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| rest-on-lid | 0 | C 0.06 / -1 / 12 | both | none / none | closed | lid | MFJFS03XZOP7E |
| grip | 42 | C 0.10 / -1 / 18 | R 0.6 | R / none | fold | lid | MFJG10AXINU2X |
| lift | 66 | C 0.06 / +1 / -8 | R 0.7 | R / L | open | lid | MFJG10AXINU2X |
| awe | 104 | S 0.10 / -1 / -6, infl 0.5 | L 0.6 | R / R | open | open | MFJFS03X49AQO |
| brace | 154 | C 0.08 / +1 / -14 | L 0.55 | L / R | closed | guard | MFJG10AX4YB91 |
| joy-a | 190 | C 0.12 / -1 / -18 | R 0.8 | L / L | star | burst-a | MFJFTELH7A9UQ, MFJFRODX2CIQ5 |
| joy-b | 228 | S 0.12 / +1 / 18, infl 0.45 | L 0.8 | R / L | star | burst-b | MFI6SYYWK85H4 |
| shrink | 272 | C 0.14 / -1 / 4 | both | none / none | fold | fold | MFJG10AV4V3U5 |

Each moment is the key's `moment` in the sheet (unchanged from run 1). Plate families: keys share one only when one inbetweens to the other without a limb crossing the torso or the figure turning; joy-b turns the other way, so burst-a and burst-b are separate, and brace (hands to the chest) is not in awe's open family.

Breakdowns, secondaries and moving holds are the run 1 authored set, unchanged (the timing shape and lead-arm rules are kept): 7 moves of 3-6 drawings (awe -> brace opens with the one anticipation at frame 130, brace -> joy-a carries the one overshoot at 1.15), poncho (stretch 0.6) and both hands (sides L and R) lag 2 drawings, a moving hold on every key.

Cards Applied (id · to · note, as recorded in `v3/references/owner/picks.json`): MFJFS03XZOP7E rest-on-lid (curve C, weight both) · MFJG10AXINU2X grip (C, back foot, lead arm) · MFJG10AXINU2X lift (back foot, lead arm, C flipped) · MFJFS03X49AQO awe (S, one foot, lead leg) · MFJG10AX4YB91 brace (C, lead arm, closed) · MFJFTELH7A9UQ joy-a (star, lead both sides) · MFJFRODX2CIQ5 joy-a (C) · MFI6SYYWK85H4 joy-b (S, one foot, opposite arm and leg lead) · MFJG10AV4V3U5 shrink (C, fold). `eagle_board.py ledger`: pose section 10 picks, 8 applied; 9 uses on the sheet; receipt `evidence/drive-VcQYuF`.

Probe Lines (full output `out/s01-02-probe-poses-solved.txt`), command `python3 scripts/animation/probe-poses.py v3/poses v3/keys v3/charts --joints solved`, exit 0:
`pass: poses - 1 shot(s) (solved joints): keys, line of action, twinning, weight, breakdowns, secondaries, holds, timing shape and lead arm all as declared` (line of action 16 items ok, twinning 8 ok, weight 8 ok, 7 timing-shape lines ok).

Re-key Brief (the run 1 key sheet under `--joints keys`, `out/s01-02-probe-poses-keys-before.txt`, 16 of 34 checks fail): line of action refused on rest-on-lid (reads I, bow 0.038), lift (I, 0.014), awe (I, 0.007), brace (I, 0.021), joy-b (reads C, bow 0.064, declared S); bow under 0.06 on grip (0.059) and shrink (0.045); weight refused on lift (root x 416, expected 363), awe (442 vs 317), brace (418 vs 327), joy-a (311 vs 382), joy-b (414 vs 288). All eight keys are re-drawn.

## Evaluation
Done: solved-joints probe exit 0 with its controls tripped (including the new solved-mode control: straight solved joints declared S refused on line of action only); `check-pose.mjs` 8 of 8. Not done here: nothing is measured on plates yet.

Changed: `v3/poses/s01-arrival-overwhelm.json` (cards, plateFamily, twinned.why on grip and brace, joy-b lead leg L, solved + solvedAt, note), `v3/references/owner/picks.json` (nine applies), `scripts/animation/solve-poses.mjs` (new), `scripts/animation/probe-poses.py` (`--joints keys|solved`), `scripts/animation/README.md`, `package.json` (`solve-poses`), `src/library/animation/pose.ts` (optional `solved`, `solvedAt` on `PoseKey`).

Receipt: `evidence/drive-VcQYuF`.

**Gate Coverage**:
- [1] PASS: `probe-poses.py v3/poses v3/keys v3/charts --joints solved` exits 0; control line printed first and tripped.

**GATE_REVIEW: PASS - the pose sheet passes the solved-joints contract; the measured-joints failures of the run 1 key sheet are the re-key brief for the next step**

Read `v3/creative-spec.md` (D65–D72, D74, D77, D83, Craft baseline, clean-up standard), `v3/rubric.md` (C20–C25, C31), `v3/poses/<shot>.json` (the pose contract: per key the moment, the curve class, bow and side, the weight foot, the lead arm and leg, the silhouette kind, the face state, the plate family and the solved joints; a missing or probe-refused pose sheet is BLOCKED), `v3/charts/<shot>.json` (frames and holds), `v3/layouts/<shot>.json` (the camera contract: the frame at the start and end of the move, emitter positions, the lead actor's on-screen height; a missing or unapproved layout is BLOCKED, run showcase_layout_sheet), the picks the pose sheet cites (`v3/references/owner/picks.json`, eagle ids) and each actor's `assets/<actor>/model.json` (contour standard in `contour.ratio`, D76); an actor with no approved model sheet is BLOCKED (run showcase_model_sheet). Companions are drawn from their official plates under `assets/codex` and `assets/clawd`, never from the layout sheet's loose versions; a garment transition (D69) is drawn as five flat roles, never as cloth. For each actor generate ONE key sheet per plate family through the `imagegen` tool (`tool:imagegen`): `references` are the absolute paths of the actor's model sheet, the approved pick, the shot's card files and the cited pose picks; the `prompt` lists every key of the family in order (K1…Kn: the moment, the curve in words from the declaration, which foot carries the weight, which arm and leg lead, the silhouette kind, what changes) and asks for TWO rows on one plate: ROW 1 every key as a full figure at the model sheet's scale and baseline, numbered K1…Kn left to right, pure black field, five flat colors with identity pigments by hex, pale contour at the model sheet's line (D76); ROW 2 the same keys as frame thumbnails at the layout's camera (the figure at the layout's on-screen height, the emitter where the layout puts it at that frame, the D74 hue pair as the only radiance, the leading line of the move visible), numbered F1…Fn under their keys; `out` is `out/<shot>-keys-<actor>-<family>-<NN>.png`. Row 1 is the plate that is cut; row 2 is the staging proof the render study is compared against (C25) and never cut. When the shot visits a world with its own style contract (`v3/worlds/<world>.json`, if any), row 2 is drawn in that world's line and fill language and names it; row 1 stays in the home style so the plate cuts cleanly. Then, per key: overlay it on the model sheet and report head count and limb ratios (C20, reject above 5 %); fill its silhouette black and judge whether the pose reads (C21); register the joints to the rig (`scripts/s01_keys_to_rig.py` or the skeleton toolchain of `v3/studies/tech-rig-01.md`; never estimated by hand) and measure the spine fit, bow and twinning against the pose sheet's declaration with `probe-poses.py --shot <shot>` (C31, reject a class or side that disagrees, a bow more than 0.02 under the declaration, or twinning the pose did not declare); measure contour weight, taper and closure (C22). A rejected key is regenerated once on its own plate with the failing property named in the prompt (the curve drawn in words, the limb that twinned); a second failure stays REJECTED on the sheet for the owner. Cut every accepted key into `assets/<actor>/keys/<shot>/K<n>.png` with `scripts/cutout.py --field black` (role quantization, soft alpha and contour per D71) and record sha256; write the registered joints into `v3/keys/<shot>.json` against the pose sheet's names and frames. No key is ever tweened by generation (D68). Measure row 2 against the layout: the figure's height at the start-of-move key within 5 points of the layout's, the emitter within 3 % of frame width (C25). Lay the sheet (both rows), overlays, silhouettes and the measured curve over each key into the `KeySheet` composition and render one still.

Return: Keys (actor, family, id, frame, declared curve vs measured class/bow/twinning, plate path, sha256, joints registered yes/no); Frame Keys (F1…Fn: figure height vs layout, emitter vs layout, world); Model-sheet Overlay (per key); Silhouettes; Clean-up Measured; Probe Lines; Sheet Paths; Generation Receipts; Rejected Keys; Concerns.

### Chain History (prior step outputs)

#### Step 1: Showcase Cinematography Sheet

**Summary**: Run 2 keeps the run 1 cinematography sheet and its contract (`v3/layouts/s01-arrival-overwhelm.json`); no sheet was regenerated, because the checks found no defect in it. One change: the widen now ends at zoom 0.6 (owner default recorded in the plan), not 0.425.

- **Camera**: start locked medium-wide (640, 360, x1); end the full field at (604, 103, x0.6) over frames 150-210 on ones; move: widen (pull back and up, no cut); led by the bubble swelling out of the box (f150-180), then the first stalk's curl (f180-210). Was (604, -144, x0.425); y 103 keeps the trio's feet at 688 of 720 px as the old pose did. The chart note, `v3/shots.json` camera string and `scripts/s01_chart.py` note follow.
- **Emitter**: start the box's lid seam (0.52, 0.777); end the gadget's dial, now (0.545, 0.311) of the frame (was (0.532, 0.512) at zoom 0.425; recomputed from the dial at stage (699, -124) through the new camera).
- **Figure Heights**: panel 1 78.1 % (face-derived, over-reads, see `figure.note`), panel 2 33.2 % (sheet, 0.425 framing); heads 8.0. The render stands the human at 350 px (48.6 %) at rest and 210 px (29.2 %) at the new end zoom.
- **Hue**: D74 pair radiance #0a51fb, accent #fad204 (unchanged).
- **Cards Used**: eagle-lyio3is7tokub, eagle-mf83t1h77o7bm, eagle-m92nkizilu1cb, eagle-mram46lymigko (unchanged).
- **Sheet Path**: `assets/layouts/s01-layout-02.png` (sha256 66445f7f...f19f; copy in `public/assets/layouts/` identical). Panel 2 still draws the 0.425 framing; the numbers in `cameraPose` supersede it (stated in `cameraPose.note`).
- **layout.json Path**: `v3/layouts/s01-arrival-overwhelm.json` (provisional: true). Still: `out/s01-layout-02-run2-still.png` (`LayoutSheetS01`).
- **Generation Receipt**: `evidence/s01/imagegen-layout-s01-02.json` (run 1; nothing generated in run 2).
- **Rejected Generations**: `out/s01-layout-01.png` (run 1: human at about 95 % of panel 1 against 50 % asked).
- **Concerns**: the sheet's panel 2 and the contract disagree about the end framing until the sheet is redrawn; the render and C25 read the contract. The exposure sheet (`out/s01-xsheet.json`) must be regenerated (`node scripts/s01-xsheet.mjs`) before the probes run.

#### Step 2: Showcase Motion

**Summary**: The timing chart from run 1 (`v3/charts/s01-arrival-overwhelm.json`, with `s01-arrival-overwhelm.md`) is kept; the checks found no defect in it, and its camera row now follows the layout contract's zoom 0.6. The pose pass (next step) owns how the human travels between these keys; the chart's own favour-only breakdowns are superseded there.

- **Key List (human)**: rest-on-lid 0 (hold 26), grip 42 (16), lift 66 (26), awe 104 (26), brace 154 (24), joy-a 190 (22), joy-b 228 (20), shrink 272 (148, declared long hold). These eight frames are the contract the pose sheet must keep.
- **Charts**: unchanged; non-human tracks (box.lid, bubble.size, gadget.rise/glow, codex/clawd lean, codex.catch, clawd.push, stalk0.grow, light.seam/dial/flood/grain) and 50 pieces as in run 1.
- **Staggers and Lag**: pieces start 3-5 frames apart; Codex's lean 4 frames before Clawd's; light lag 3 frames, recovery 12.
- **Boil and Pulses**: boil 3 variants at rate 4, seed 11; pulses at frame 44 (lid cracks) and 180 (the pop).
- **Camera**: locked 0-150, widen 150-210 on ones to (604, 103, x0.6) per `v3/layouts/s01-arrival-overwhelm.json` `cameraPose`, held to 420; led by the bubble then stalk0's curl. Chart note, `v3/shots.json` and `scripts/s01_chart.py` updated from 0.425.
- **Checks run**: `probe-timeline.py v3/timeline.json` passes (arrival 0-180, everything-at-once 180-420, no crossing in the shot); `v3/blocking/arrival.json` and `everything-at-once.json` exist; the eight chart keys equal the pose sheet's keys by name and frame (`probe-poses` keys category: 8 of 8 ok).
- **Library Changes Needed**: none new for this step.
- **Artifact Handoff**: `v3/charts/s01-arrival-overwhelm.json`, `v3/charts/s01-arrival-overwhelm.md`; no `motion.md` is written (the chart .md carries the per-beat rhythm, as in run 1).
- **Concerns**: the chart still holds the 33 favour-only breakdowns of run 1; they are not played (the pose sheet's breakdowns replace them in `shotS01Plan.ts`) but they remain in the file as the older reading.
